description: Hardware tag detection. Each rule sets its tag when all keys of 'when' (or of any object in 'anyOf') match the read-only hardware facts. Regex values are case-insensitive where marked (?i).

rules.basis: Intel CPU with fewer threads than twice its cores: P-cores have Hyper-Threading, E-cores do not (12th gen and newer).
Family 6, model 183 or 191 (Raptor Lake-S), 13th/14th gen name without a mobile suffix, not inside a virtual machine.
AMD Ryzen processor.
Ryzen 9 X3D models with two core complexes, only one of which carries 3D V-Cache.
Ryzen 5/7 X3D models with a single core complex.
Active GPU with PCI vendor ID 10DE (NVIDIA).
Active GPU with PCI vendor ID 1002 (AMD).
Active GPU with PCI vendor ID 8086 (Intel).
Intel Arc A- or B-series discrete GPU (for example A770 or B580); integrated 'Arc Graphics' does not match.
A system battery or a portable chassis type, and not a virtual machine.
No battery, no portable chassis type, not a virtual machine.
'powercfg /a' lists Standby (S0 Low Power Idle) as available.
Intel Ethernet Controller I225 (name or PCI device ID).
Intel Ethernet Controller I226 (name or PCI device ID).
Network controller with PCI vendor ID 10EC (Realtek).
Network controller with PCI vendor ID 1D6A (Aquantia, now Marvell) or 11AB (Marvell).
Network controller named Killer.
The disk holding the Windows partition reports bus type NVMe.
The Windows disk is a SATA solid-state drive.
The Windows disk reports media type HDD.
Installed memory below 16 GB.
Installed memory from 16 GB up to (not including) 32 GB.
Installed memory from 32 GB up to (not including) 64 GB.
Installed memory of 64 GB or more.
System manufacturer or model names a hypervisor (Hyper-V 'Virtual Machine', VMware, VirtualBox, KVM, QEMU, Xen, Parallels). HypervisorPresent is not used: it is also true on PCs with VBS.
